generated suggestions save, restage, rej.note: A paragraph suggested before the paragraph a pending join runs into: the suggestion goes right beside the paragraph it names, a direct edit before the whole join.
A paragraph suggested after a table-cell paragraph, in a document with a pending join, goes beside the outermost table.
A paragraph suggested after a cell paragraph whose mark is a pending insertion goes beside the outermost table.
A suggested removal of the last paragraph joins it with the one before when accepted: the same text, the later paragraph's id.
A suggested paragraph inserted after the body paragraph before a terminal table retains the source mark so rejection restores the original container.
